title: The Night Garden
text: A garden of pale flowers blooms only in the dark, white as bone, wide open and swaying. Their scent is heavy and sweet as old perfume. Breathe it, and you forget why you came; breathe it longer, and you forget there was anywhere else.

options.label: Pick a pale flower each and breathe deep of forgetting.

outcomes.text: Sweet forgetting brings rest without dreams.
You forget the way, and walk somewhere you did not mean to go.

options.label: The toughest holds their breath and leads the rest through the scent.

outcomes.text: They bring every one of you out, gasping. Leading cost them dearly, and their blood is up for it.

options.label: The wisest studies the flowers to learn what they could be made into.

outcomes.text: They would make a drug for sleepless nights, worth its weight, and worse in larger doses.

options.label: The Alterer changes their own lungs to bear the scent, and leads the way.

outcomes.text: Their chest goes strange and wide for an hour as they lead the party through on one long breath. It hurts after.
